comparison_reference_solver: same final FM_STANDARD checkpoint with Heun sampling; Euler reference is reported separately

fixed_comparisons.question: complete Brownian state diffusion method with corresponding FP target

paired_difference_definition: comparison model metric minus that comparison's reference model metric at the same training seed; FM_STANDARD references use Heun
interval_method: two-sided 95% Student t interval over training seeds; incomplete seed groups explicitly labeled partial
hypothesis_test: two-sided paired Student t test; descriptive and assumption-dependent with five seeds
multiple_comparison_method: Holm correction within each dataset and metric over seven fixed comparisons (three research contrasts and four model-versus-standard-Heun contrasts); raw intervals and adjusted p values remain separate
sampling_replication: independent ensembles retained inside each checkpoint; interacting particles/projections/metric pairs are not independent training seeds
missing_policy: Retain all 75 new configurations and 25 per task. Never impute failed/blocked runs or relabel Phase1 metrics. Partial seed groups report n/5.
interpretation_limits: Three fully generated sequence tasks with observation-time dependency, D128 complete state. Generation-time field history and observation-time dependence are distinct. No robot result or predetermined winner. Five seeds give assumption-dependent inference.
secondary_dependency_evaluation: Task-specific early/late consistency and pairing-shuffle diagnostics, channel-aware ACF/covariance, power spectrum and time differences, real-validation-selected downstream ridge TSTR and count-matched/full TRTR. Registered in each METRIC_SPEC; not part of generator loss.
multiplicity_scope: Holm within each dataset and each metric, seven predeclared contrasts. No joint family-wise guarantee across different metrics or datasets; secondary dependency diagnostics interpreted descriptively.
fixed_real_reference_policy: Deterministic reference metrics may be repeated in each run for provenance. A zero across-seed SD of that repeated constant is not a zero uncertainty claim for the real population.
